The build and package functions do not execute arbitrary code, download additional content at runtime, or exfiltrate data. All operations are confined to standard packaging workflows.

While the checksum is provided only for the source tarball and not for VCS sources (which isn't applicable here), this is normal for tagged releases. No dangerous commands like `eval`, `base64`, or `curl|bash` are present. The package aligns with expected functionality for a KDE thumbnailer and shows no evidence of supply-chain compromise.
